slides.headline: Rubio faces criticism over Putin in Miami
slides.body: A Miami Herald opinion article criticized Marco Rubio over support for welcoming Vladimir Putin to Miami.

slides.headline: That follows Trump’s Miami G20 invitation
slides.body: Trump invited Putin to the G20 summit in Miami, and Russia said it would consider the invitation.

slides.headline: That also puts Rubio’s Miami roots in the story
slides.body: Rubio was born and raised in Miami, represented Florida in the U.S. Senate from 2011 to 2025, and became secretary of state in 2025.

slides.headline: Which brings Putin’s Ukraine record to South Florida
slides.body: Putin launched Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, and the International Criminal Court issued an arrest warrant for him in March 2023.

slides.headline: And senators are urging Trump to disinvite him
slides.body: Senators urged Trump to disinvite Putin from the Miami G20 summit, while the EU plans to condemn the war in Ukraine if Putin attends.
